top_signals.title: ‘It’s really not just a blockchain anymore’: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s path to 2030
top_signals.summary: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said Ethereum is "really not just a blockchain anymore" and laid out how its design will change by 2030 in a post.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: UK has ‘low capital gains tax rates’, Healey says
top_signals.summary: The UK enjoys the lowest capital gains tax rate of any major European economy, Chancellor John Healey has said, raising the prospect of another hike at the Budget.  Healey has said he wanted to improve the UK’s economic fortunes yet pointed to the UK’s competitiveness on capital taxes when speaking about business confidence.  He told [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
